errors.text: The proposed optimum is 900–950 °C, whereas the target mechanism and best measured properties occur after SPS at 1000 °C.
The central structural mediator is misidentified as coherent TiAl/Ti3Al precipitates; the target reports uniformly distributed oxide barrier phases such as AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3.
The hypothesis predicts relative density above 98%, contradicting the target optimum of 96.7%.
The proposed oxidation experiment uses 800 °C rather than the target 900 °C and omits the required 3.5 wt% NaCl corrosion comparison.
The cited evidence concerns a chemically distinct refractory HEA and TiO precipitation, so it does not substantiate TiAl/Ti3Al precipitation or the claimed MgO–TiO2–Al2O3 barrier in Mg-Al-Ti-V-Fe-Co.
